 Louisiana LIHEAP Winter Heating Assistance Program Is Now Open
 by BPT Staff 
 November 18, 2026 
 written by BPT Staff 
 November 18, 2026 
 0 comments 
 0 Facebook Twitter Pinterest Tumblr VK Whatsapp Email 
 35 
  As temperatures begin to drop across Louisiana, Southwestern Electric Power Co. (SWEPCO) is reminding customers applications for the federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) winter heating assistance season opened Nov. 15. The program helps income-qualified households pay winter heating bills and is available on a first-come, first-served basis until funds are exhausted.
 “Programs like LIHEAP can provide meaningful relief for eligible families,” said Paul Pratt, director of Customer Services and Marketing for SWEPCO. “That’s why we’re committed to connecting customers with resources that help them manage their energy use and get more value from every energy dollar. We encourage customers to apply early to take advantage of the program.”
 Customers across the Ark-La-Tex can access LIHEAP assistance, with application periods varying by state. Louisiana customers may apply for winter heating assistance beginning Nov. 15 and are encouraged to contact their local administering agency for application information and availability. Eligible Texas customers can apply for LIHEAP assistance year-round, subject to available funding. In Arkansas, the next winter LIHEAP assistance period is scheduled to begin Jan. 4, 2027. Because LIHEAP funding is limited and distributed on a first-come, first-served basis, customers are encouraged to apply as early as possible.
 Administering agencies across Louisiana, Texas and Arkansas play a critical role in connecting eligible households with LIHEAP assistance. SWEPCO appreciates the dedicated staff and community partners who work directly with customers to process applications and help families access this important federal program. Their efforts help ensure assistance reaches those who need it most during the winter heating season.
 In addition to seeking assistance through LIHEAP, customers can take steps to stay comfortable while lowering energy costs this winter.
 Setting thermostats to the lowest comfortable temperature
 Lowering temperatures while sleeping or away from home
 replacing furnace filters regularly, and sealing air leaks around doors and windows
 Customers can also increase efficiency by using LED lighting, washing clothes in cold water when possible, and opening curtains during sunny days to take advantage of natural warmth before closing them at night to help retain heat.
 Customers looking for additional support can visit SWEPCO.com/billhelp. By answering a few simple questions, customers can find assistance options tailored to their unique circumstances, including LIHEAP, payment plans, payment extensions, Average Monthly Payments and the Pay As You Go program. The online tool helps connect customers with programs and resources that can make managing energy costs easier throughout the year. For additional information about LIHEAP eligibility, local administering agencies and other bill assistance programs, customers can also visit SWEPCO.com/billhelp .
